say:19:1320409018:0.source_cn: 没问题，我可是很有信誉的！嚯嚯！

say:20:1320409019:0.text: We've got ourselves a lovely agreement, then. I'll draft up the contract once I'm back at the inn.
say:20:1320409019:0.source_cn: 好，那我们就谈妥了。等返回旅店之后我会写一份合同给你。

say:21:1320409020:0.text: Perfect! You're <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend, so I trust ya!
say:21:1320409020:0.male: Perfect! You're <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend, so I trust ya!
say:21:1320409020:0.female: Perfect! You're <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s friend, so I trust ya!

say:22:1320409021:0.text: By the way, when do you need the temperature detector?
say:22:1320409021:0.source_cn: 对了，我得问一嘴，温差探测器你们什么时候要？

say:23:1320409022:0.text: As soon as possible, of course!

say:24:1320409023:0.text: Oho, well then, you'd better get to rounding up the materials.
say:24:1320409023:0.source_cn: 哦嚯，那你们得抓紧时间去找材料了。

choice_prompt:25:1320409023.text: Oho, well then, you'd better get to rounding up the materials.
choice_prompt:25:1320409023.source_cn: 哦嚯，那你们得抓紧时间去找材料了。

say:26:1320409024:0.text: I got most of 'em! But I'm missing a couple of special items.
say:26:1320409024:0.source_cn: 我这里的材料当然是能用的都会用上，但难免缺少一些特殊的...

say:27:1320409027:0.text: Alright, what materials are you missing?
say:27:1320409027:0.source_cn: 矮人兄弟，现在还缺什么材料？

say:28:1320409028:0.text: Just a log from an <style="highlight">icewreath pine</style> and a <style="highlight">frost crystal</style> from an ice elemental.

say:29:1320409029:0.text: There's icewreath pines up north, and ice elementals just outside of the town. Get moving!
say:29:1320409029:0.source_cn: 镇子北边就有寒轮松树，郊外应该也有不少冰元素。快去快回吧。

choice:25:0:1.text: Don't you have lots of materials?
choice:25:0:1.male: Don't you have lots of materials?
choice:25:0:1.female: Don't you have lots of materials?

say:31:1320409025:0.text: Oh, I meant no labor costs! Free and no charge aren't the same thing.
say:31:1320409025:0.source_cn: 唉，我说的不收费是指手工费，和完全免费还是不一样的。

say:32:1320409026:1.text: Plus, I'm throwing in premium materials here and not asking for a thing.
say:32:1320409026:1.source_cn: 再说了，还有很多贵重材料都得我自己出，我都没说要收这部分钱。

choice:25:1:2.text: Didn't you say this was free?
choice:25:1:2.male: Didn't you say this was free?
choice:25:1:2.female: Didn't you say this was free?

say:0:1320410001:0.text: *Sigh* You merchants really never hand out freebies. Even Whistler, Hardhead, and I couldn't out-bargain you.
say:0:1320410001:0.source_cn: 唉，你们这些商人从来都不肯吃亏。我和尖哨、铁头加起来也...

say:1:1320410002:0.text: Aha, don't worry, we're partners from now on!
say:1:1320410002:0.source_cn: 哈哈，别怕，我们以后就是合作伙伴了。

say:0:1320411001:0.text: We've collected all the materials! Let's get them back to Hugin.
say:0:1320411001:0.source_cn: 寒轮松树和碎晶锥都收集到了，赶快交给呼金让他制作温差探...
say:0:1320411001:0.male: We've collected all the materials! Let's get them back to Hugin.
say:0:1320411001:0.female: We've collected all the materials! Let's get them back to Hugin.

say:3:1320412001:0.source_cn: 呼金！你需要的材料我们都找到了！

say:4:1320412002:0.text: I knew I could count on you! Even on this icy mountain, you're quicker than a snow hare!
say:4:1320412002:0.source_cn: 嚯，真不愧是你们！到了这冰天雪地的地方，手脚还是一样麻利！

say:5:1320412003:0.text: Alright, leave the rest to me!
say:5:1320412003:0.source_cn: 行了，接下来就看我的吧！

narration:6:1320412004:0.text: With a confident grin, Hugin grabs his tools, and after a symphony of clanking and hammering, the temperature detector is complete.
narration:6:1320412004:0.source_cn: 呼金拿起工具敲敲打打，好一阵之后，才终于做好了温差探测器

say:7:1320412005:1.text: Wow! Is this the final version of the detector?
say:7:1320412005:1.source_cn: 哇！这就是探测器的最终成品了吗？

say:8:1320412006:0.text: Yup! You can call it the "Boil-O-Scope"! It detects areas with big temperature differences within a certain range, and it's unaffected by the terrain.
say:8:1320412006:0.source_cn: 没错！你们可以叫他“热灯”。他能在一定范围内发现温差较...

say:11:1320412007:0.text: Um... So how do I use device?

say:12:1320412008:0.text: Simple, just keep it with you! When it senses a temperature difference, it'll make a sound and point to the exact location.
say:12:1320412008:0.source_cn: 很简单，带着他四处走走就行。只要识别到温差，他就会发出...

say:13:1320412009:0.text: But be careful! I had to use rare materials from my homeland to get it this precise. If it breaks, I can't fix it.
say:13:1320412009:0.source_cn: 你们使用的时候千万得小心！为了提高热灯的精准度，我用了...

say:14:1320412010:0.text: Understood, I'll be careful. Thanks a lot!

say:16:1320412011:0.text: Madam Gerda, where should we start looking?
say:16:1320412011:0.source_cn: 格尔达女士，接下来我们去哪里探测温差呢？

say:17:1320412012:0.text: The river near the inn and the hills behind it. There might be wild hot springs around those spots.

say:18:1320412013:0.text: Let's head to the river first. It's on the way back to the inn anyway.
say:18:1320412013:0.source_cn: 先去河边看看吧！正好返回旅店的路上要经过那里。

say:0:1320413001:0.text: Are you sure there could be hot springs near the river? Isn't the water there frozen solid?
say:0:1320413001:0.source_cn: 河边真的会有温泉吗？满满记得那里湖面上都是冰呢……

say:1:1320413002:0.text: We won't know unless we try.
say:1:1320413002:0.source_cn: 总归要试试看才知道嘛。

say:0:1320413101:0.source_cn: 就这里吧！用探测器看看附近有没有野温泉。

say:4:1320414001:0.source_cn: 主人，格尔达女士！探测器响了！

say:5:1320414002:0.text: Huh... the sound's cutting in and out, and the temperature readings are all over the place.
say:5:1320414002:0.source_cn: 咦……它的响声怎么断断续续的？显示屏上的温差也时有时无。

say:6:1320414003:0.text: That's strange. A hot spring's heat should be steady, not fluctuating like this.
say:6:1320414003:0.source_cn: 真奇怪，温泉和附近的温差应该是恒定的，不可能这样变来变去。

say:7:1320414004:1.text: Do you think there's something wrong with the detector?
say:7:1320414004:1.source_cn: 难不成是探测器不够准确？

choice_prompt:8:1320414004.text: Do you think there's something wrong with the detector?
choice_prompt:8:1320414004.source_cn: 难不成是探测器不够准确？

say:9:1320414006:0.text: Sweetheart, don't overthink it. We can just go check and find out!
say:9:1320414006:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，别纠结了，我们过去看看不就一切都清楚了！

choice:8:0:1.text: Hugin wouldn't make a faulty tool.
choice:8:0:1.male: Hugin wouldn't make a faulty tool.
choice:8:0:1.female: Hugin wouldn't make a faulty tool.

say:12:1320414005:0.text: But what could be moving around that gives off such high heat?
say:12:1320414005:0.source_cn: 可是，什么东西会不断运动，温度还很高呢……？

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 或许是识别到了会动的东西？

say:0:1320415001:0.text: Aren't those Cryonaia's minions up ahead?! Those soldiers need backup!
say:0:1320415001:0.source_cn: 前面那几个不是冰恶魔的眷属吗？！我们得帮帮那些士兵！

say:0:1320416001:0.text: How'd the detector lead us straight to a pack of bad guys?!
say:0:1320416001:0.source_cn: 不是找温泉吗？为什么探测器会找到一群恶魔眷属啊！

say:3:1320417001:0.text: Magister, Madam Gerda, we're truly grateful for your help.
say:3:1320417001:0.male: Magister, Madam Gerda, we're truly grateful for your help.
say:3:1320417001:0.female: Magister, Madam Gerda, we're truly grateful for your help.

say:4:1320417002:0.text: We were tracking the escaped Hypogean minions from the castle. They caught us off guard with an ambush here. If not for you, we might've had more wounded.
say:4:1320417002:0.source_cn: 我们正奉命追击从城堡中逃离的恶魔眷属，没想到它们竟然埋...

say:5:1320417003:0.text: Oh come now, no need to be so formal! Clearing out the evil helps out my inn, too.
say:5:1320417003:0.source_cn: 不用这么客气！清除附近的恶魔，也是在保护白熊温泉旅店。

say:6:1320417004:1.text: That's weird... After we took those guys down, the detector stopped beeping.
say:6:1320417004:1.source_cn: 奇怪……打败冰恶魔的眷属后，探测器就不再响了。

choice_prompt:7:1320417004.text: That's weird... After we took those guys down, the detector stopped beeping.
choice_prompt:7:1320417004.source_cn: 奇怪……打败冰恶魔的眷属后，探测器就不再响了。

say:9:1320417007:0.text: Ah, I suppose the minions brought down the temperature, but defeating them raised it back up! So every time one got taken down, the temperature would fluctuate.
say:9:1320417007:0.source_cn: 唔……那时有时无的温差，大概是因为这些恶魔眷属接连死亡...
say:9:1320417007:0.male: Ah, I suppose the minions brought down the temperature, but defeating them raised it back up! So every time one got taken down, the temperature would fluctuate.
say:9:1320417007:0.female: Ah, I suppose the minions brought down the temperature, but defeating them raised it back up! So every time one got taken down, the temperature would fluctuate.

say:11:1320417009:1.text: Well, on the bright side, at least it shows that the detector is sensitive to temperature differences. It's just that we're picking up cold instead of the heat we were hoping for.
say:11:1320417009:1.source_cn: 往好处想，至少这证明温差探测器很灵敏，只不过这种偏向寒...

say:13:1320417011:0.text: Yes, it's a new tool I had a craftsman make. It detects temperature differences, I was hoping to use it to locate wild hot springs.
say:13:1320417011:0.source_cn: 是我们请工匠制造的新工具，能识别哪里存在温差，方便我寻...

say:15:1320417013:0.text: Could you use the detector to help us find more of those minions?
say:15:1320417013:0.male: Could you use the detector to help us find more of those minions?
say:15:1320417013:0.female: Could you use the detector to help us find more of those minions?

say:16:1320417014:0.text: To be honest, there are still a few that got away, and we haven't been able to find them. They're quite skilled at hiding, and this terrain is pretty tricky. We haven't had much luck.
say:16:1320417014:0.source_cn: 实不相瞒，还有几只逃脱的恶魔眷属一直没能找到。它们非常...

say:17:1320417015:0.text: But with the detector, it would be much easier!
say:17:1320417015:0.source_cn: 如果有温差探测器帮忙，事情就简单得多了！

say:18:1320417016:0.text: Where do you think the remaining Hypogean minions went?
say:18:1320417016:0.source_cn: 还没抓住的那些恶魔眷属，都逃往了哪里？

say:19:1320417017:0.text: From the clues we've gathered, they're likely hiding <style="highlight">near the river</style>.
say:19:1320417017:0.source_cn: 据我们找到的线索，很可能就隐藏在<style=high...

choice_prompt:20:1320417017.text: From the clues we've gathered, they're likely hiding <style="highlight">near the river</style>.
choice_prompt:20:1320417017.source_cn: 据我们找到的线索，很可能就隐藏在<style=highlight>附近的河面周围</style>。

say:21:1320417018:0.text: Don't worry! I've set up traps around the inn. At the very least, I can ensure the guests are safe.
say:21:1320417018:0.source_cn: 不用担心，旅店里有我布置好的机关，至少肯定能保证客人的安全。
say:21:1320417018:0.male: Don't worry! I've set up traps around the inn. At the very least, I can ensure the guests are safe.
say:21:1320417018:0.female: Don't worry! I've set up traps around the inn. At the very least, I can ensure the guests are safe.

say:22:1320417020:0.text: It's fine, let's deal with the monsters first!
say:22:1320417020:0.source_cn: 没关系，先去找恶魔眷属吧！
say:22:1320417020:0.male: It's fine, let's deal with the monsters first!
say:22:1320417020:0.female: It's fine, let's deal with the monsters first!

say:23:1320417021:0.text: Making sure the area around the inn is safe is more important than finding new hot springs. It's all part of the investment.
say:23:1320417021:0.source_cn: 比起开辟新温泉，还是旅店的周边安全更重要。这也是一种“...
say:23:1320417021:0.male: Making sure the area around the inn is safe is more important than finding new hot springs. It's all part of the investment.
say:23:1320417021:0.female: Making sure the area around the inn is safe is more important than finding new hot springs. It's all part of the investment.

say:24:1320417022:0.text: Thank you, everyone! I'll gather the soldiers and prepare to set out.
say:24:1320417022:0.source_cn: 多谢几位！我这就让士兵们整队，准备出发。

choice:20:0:1.text: That's so close to the inn...
choice:20:0:1.male: That's so close to the inn...
choice:20:0:1.female: That's so close to the inn...

choice:20:1:2.text: But what about the hot springs?
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 和可能有温泉的地方不一样
choice:20:1:2.male: But what about the hot springs?
choice:20:1:2.female: But what about the hot springs?

say:26:1320417019:0.text: Well, we did start this whole adventure to find new hot springs...
say:26:1320417019:0.male: Well, we did start this whole adventure to find new hot springs...
say:26:1320417019:0.female: Well, we did start this whole adventure to find new hot springs...

choice:20:2:3.source_cn: 先找恶魔眷属还是先找温泉？

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 难道它识别到的是寒冷的温差？

say:27:1320417006:0.text: I have a theory—what if it was picking up the cold temperature from Cryonaia's minions?
say:27:1320417006:0.source_cn: 我有个猜测——说不定它识别到的是这些恶魔眷属所散发出来...
say:27:1320417006:0.male: I have a theory—what if it was picking up the cold temperature from Cryonaia's minions?
say:27:1320417006:0.female: I have a theory—what if it was picking up the cold temperature from Cryonaia's minions?

say:0:1320418001:0.text: Once we find them, let's take them out quickly!
say:0:1320418001:0.source_cn: 逃脱的恶魔眷属很可能隐藏在河面附近，得抓紧时间清除。

say:1:1320419001:0.source_cn: 主……主人！探测器的反应好强烈！

say:2:1320419002:0.text: They must be close. Stay alert!
say:2:1320419002:0.source_cn: 冰恶魔的眷属肯定就在这附近，一定要多加小心！
say:2:1320419002:0.male: They must be close. Stay alert!
say:2:1320419002:0.female: They must be close. Stay alert!

say:0:1320420001:0.text: There they are! One of them looks different...
say:0:1320420001:0.source_cn: 恶魔眷属果然在这里！里面有一只好像不太对劲……！

say:1:1320420002:0.text: That one's giving off intense cold... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, be careful!
say:1:1320420002:0.male: That one's giving off intense cold... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, be careful!
say:1:1320420002:0.female: That one's giving off intense cold... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, be careful!

say:3:1320421001:0.text: Whew... Seems like we got them all.
say:3:1320421001:0.source_cn: 呼……应该，没有其他恶魔了吧……

say:4:1320421002:0.text: The detector isn't making any noise, so it seems we've cleared them out.
say:4:1320421002:0.source_cn: 温差探测器没发出声音，应该全都解决了。

say:5:1320421003:0.text: Yes, now all the monsters that escaped from the castle have been eliminated.
say:5:1320421003:0.source_cn: 是的，我们清点过数量，从城堡中逃脱的恶魔眷属已经全部清除了。

say:6:1320421004:1.text: Good! Now nothing can harm the guests of my inn!
say:6:1320421004:1.source_cn: 那就好，只要白熊温泉旅店附近恢复了安全就行。

say:7:1320421005:0.text: Thank you for all your help! We shall return and report to the higher ups.
say:7:1320421005:0.source_cn: 多谢几位的帮助！我们这就回去将这个消息汇报给侍卫长。

say:10:1320421006:0.text: Great, the monsters have been dealt with! Let's start searching for hot springs now.
say:10:1320421006:0.source_cn: 太好了，恶魔眷属的事顺利解决！接下来我们是不是要继续寻...

say:11:1320421007:0.text: Let's begin at the <style="highlight">hills behind the inn</style>.

say:0:1320422001:0.text: Those hills are pretty big, but close enough to the inn. An ideal spot for a new hot spring to be found.
say:0:1320422001:0.source_cn: 说起来，旅店后山还挺大的，不知道野温泉会在哪。

say:1:1320422002:0.text: Imagine if we found multiple hot springs! I could open up a whole resort!
say:1:1320422002:0.source_cn: 唉，要是能开辟出更大规模的温泉就好了。

narration:0:1320423001:0.text: You walk around for a while, but the temperature detector doesn't react at all.
narration:0:1320423001:0.source_cn: 你们尝试着使用温差探测器，它却没有任何反应

say:4:1320423002:0.text: Why isn't it making any noise? We've been at this for ages!
say:4:1320423002:0.source_cn: 奇怪，探测器怎么没反应了？不仅没有声音，显示屏也不亮了！

say:5:1320423003:0.text: Hmm? Let me take a look.

say:6:1320423004:1.text: Oh dear... It seems to be damaged. There's a small hole in the back.
say:6:1320423004:1.source_cn: ……探测器似乎损坏了，背面有被冰锥穿透的痕迹。

say:8:1320423006:0.text: *Sigh* The battle earlier was quite intense, so it's not surprising.
say:8:1320423006:0.source_cn: 唉，刚才的战斗那么激烈，难免有东西会被损坏，这也正常。

say:9:1320423007:0.text: But without the detector, we can't find any hot springs...
say:9:1320423007:0.source_cn: 可是这样的话，我们就没办法找温泉了……

say:10:1320423008:0.text: Come on, sweetheart, don't be so down.
say:10:1320423008:0.source_cn: 好啦，亲爱的，我可没有这么脆弱。

say:11:1320423009:0.text: We'll manage without it! Worst case, I'll just go back to my tried-and-true method, like back when I found the first hot spring near the inn. It'll just take a little longer.
say:11:1320423009:0.source_cn: 没有探测器也没事！大不了用我的老方法找温泉，也不过是要...

choice_prompt:12:1320423009.text: We'll manage without it! Worst case, I'll just go back to my tried-and-true method, like back when I found the first hot spring near the inn. It'll just take a little longer.
choice_prompt:12:1320423009.source_cn: 没有探测器也没事！大不了用我的老方法找温泉，也不过是要多花点时间而已。

say:13:1320423011:0.text: Mmmhmm! Just relying on my eyes and nose—trust me, darling, you'll know when we're close. Stick with me, and soon enough, we'll be soaking in our very own steamy paradise!
say:13:1320423011:0.source_cn: 想当初，我可是凭着天生敏锐的嗅觉和视力，就找到了旅店现...
say:13:1320423011:0.male: Mmmhmm! Just relying on my eyes and nose—trust me, darling, you'll know when we're close. Stick with me, and soon enough, we'll be soaking in our very own steamy paradise!
say:13:1320423011:0.female: Mmmhmm! Just relying on my eyes and nose—trust me, darling, you'll know when we're close. Stick with me, and soon enough, we'll be soaking in our very own steamy paradise!

say:14:1320423012:0.text: You sniffed it out using just your eyes and nose?!
say:14:1320423012:0.source_cn: 只通过嗅觉和视力就能找到吗？！

say:15:1320423013:0.text: Yep! There had just been a heavy snowfall, and I was out in the mountains gathering supplies when I saw steam rising and smelled sulfur. I followed it, did a bit of exploring, and voila! I found the hot spring.
say:15:1320423013:0.source_cn: 没错。当时是在一场大雪之后，我进山采东西时看到了水汽升...

say:16:1320423014:1.text: Of course there was some luck involved, but my sharp senses played a big part too!
say:16:1320423014:1.source_cn: 虽说也有运气的成分在，但我的眼睛和鼻子也功不可没！

say:17:1320423015:0.text: So just leave the hot spring search to me this time. All you need to do is tag along and enjoy the view.

say:18:1320423016:0.source_cn: 嗯，我和满满也会用嗅觉一起帮你找温泉的！

say:19:1320423017:0.source_cn: 好啊，那我就提前谢谢你们了。

say:9:1320425007:0.text: Your contribution in clearing out the remains of the Frost Furie's minions cannot be overlooked, so I gathered these for you. I hope you'll accept them.

choice_prompt:10:1320425007.text: Your contribution in clearing out the remains of the Frost Furie's minions cannot be overlooked, so I gathered these for you. I hope you'll accept them.
choice_prompt:10:1320425007.source_cn: 在清除恶魔眷属这件事上，几位的贡献不可忽视，所以我特意采摘了这些松果，还望你们能够收下！

say:12:1320425010:0.text: What is it, Madam Gerda? Is there something wrong with the pinecones?
say:12:1320425010:0.source_cn: 怎么了？格尔达女士，这些松果哪里不对吗？

say:14:1320425012:0.text: Sulfur?! Could that mean a hot spring where these pinecones were found?

say:15:1320425013:0.text: Not necessarily. Lots of things carry a sulfur smell, so it might not mean anything. But... maybe it's worth a look.

say:16:1320425014:1.text: Do you remember where exactly you picked these cones?
say:16:1320425014:1.source_cn: 领队，你还记得采摘松果的地方在哪吗？

say:17:1320425015:0.text: Sure do. It was near the frozen river north of the inn, by the waterfall along the riverbank.

say:18:1320425016:0.text: Then let's head over there! There could really be a hidden hot spring!

choice:10:1:2.text: I suppose I can take these...

choice:10:1:2.female: I suppose I can take these...

say:20:1320425008:0.text: Uh... noted! I'll remember that for next time!

say:20:1320425008:0.female: Uh... noted! I'll remember that for next time!

say:0:1320426001:0.text: Hmm... I do smell sulfur here.

say:1:1320427002:0.source_cn: 硫磺的气味……像是从这些巨石后飘来的！

say:3:1320428001:0.text: It's huge, like a hundred Chippys stacked up!
say:3:1320428001:0.source_cn: 这几块石头真大啊……感觉比一百个满满加起来还要大！

say:4:1320428002:0.text: But the scent's definitely coming from behind it... If we want to know for sure, we'll have to find a way around.

say:5:1320428003:0.text: But the other side is all mountains, there's no path...
say:5:1320428003:0.source_cn: 可是，另一边全都是山啊！看起来不像是有路的样子。

say:6:1320428004:0.text: Well, we can't just give up!

say:7:1320428005:0.text: Maybe we can ask Hugin for some bombs to blast through?

say:9:1320428007:0.female: All right, all right. No need to go to all that trouble.

say:10:1320428008:0.text: Sweetheart, step back. I'll take care of this stubborn rock myself.
say:10:1320428008:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们退后几步，让我来解决这些碍事的石头吧。

choice:8:0:1.text: Or we could climb over it.
choice:8:0:1.male: Or we could climb over it.
choice:8:0:1.female: Or we could climb over it.

say:12:1320428006:0.text: Oh, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You and Madam Gerda might manage that, but Chippy and I definitely can't!
say:12:1320428006:0.male: Oh, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You and Madam Gerda might manage that, but Chippy and I definitely can't!
say:12:1320428006:0.female: Oh, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You and Madam Gerda might manage that, but Chippy and I definitely can't!

choice:8:1:2.text: Bombs might be the way to go.
choice:8:1:2.male: Bombs might be the way to go.
choice:8:1:2.female: Bombs might be the way to go.

say:0:1320430001:0.text: It really is a hot spring!!

say:1:1320430002:0.text: Whew, that sulfur smell is intense.

say:3:1320431001:0.text: There are so many little animals here! Looks like they're here to enjoy the hot springs.
say:3:1320431001:0.source_cn: 这里有好多小动物呀！看来它们平时经常会来这里泡温泉呢~

say:5:1320431003:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈，如果是你们两个小家伙想进去，我想它们不会拒绝的。

say:6:1320431004:0.text: Though... let's hold off on the idea of developing this hot spring.

choice_prompt:7:1320431004.source_cn: 不过……开发这个温泉的计划就暂时放一放吧。这个温泉还是不要开发为好。

say:9:1320431006:0.text: I wouldn't want to be the bad guy who takes over their territory.

say:9:1320431006:0.male: I wouldn't want to be the bad guy who takes over their territory.
say:9:1320431006:0.female: I wouldn't want to be the bad guy who takes over their territory.

say:10:1320431011:0.text: Besides, who wouldn't want to keep a peaceful place like this for the animals? It's just... perfect. And they are so adorable, soaking without a care in the world!

say:10:1320431011:0.male: Besides, who wouldn't want to keep a peaceful place like this for the animals? It's just... perfect. And they are so adorable, soaking without a care in the world!
say:10:1320431011:0.female: Besides, who wouldn't want to keep a peaceful place like this for the animals? It's just... perfect. And they are so adorable, soaking without a care in the world!

say:12:1320431013:0.text: But Chippy's a little bummed we didn't find a new hot spring we could use, especially after all that searching...
say:12:1320431013:0.source_cn: 可是一想到我们忙了这么久，最后却没能找到合适的新温泉，...

say:13:1320431014:0.text: Oh, don't be too down! A knight has to stay full of spirit, right?
say:13:1320431014:0.source_cn: 好啦，别垂头丧气的了，一名骑士不应该时时刻刻都很精神吗？

say:17:1320431008:0.female: But sometimes the best treasures are the ones we just admire from afar. It's their little slice of heaven, after all.

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 好不容易才找到的温泉！

say:18:1320431009:0.text: Yes, dearie, you get what I'm thinking!
say:18:1320431009:0.male: Yes, dearie, you get what I'm thinking!
say:18:1320431009:0.female: Yes, dearie, you get what I'm thinking!

say:19:1320431010:0.female: Some things are best left as they are. This spot is their little paradise.

choice:7:2:3.text: You don't want to disturb them?
choice:7:2:3.male: You don't want to disturb them?
choice:7:2:3.female: You don't want to disturb them?

say:0:1320432001:0.source_cn: 回白熊旅店休息一下吧，我还没有犒劳你们呢。

say:4:1320433002:0.text: Way busier than that quiet hot spring we just found. Now Chippy's jealous of those little animals!
say:4:1320433002:0.source_cn: 是啊，刚刚找到的那个温泉里都没有这么拥挤……满满突然有...

say:6:1320433004:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，那只是一个还没落实的计划。为了一片快乐的动物栖...

say:15:1320433014:0.text: Oh, it's nothing! I still feel like there are so many things I haven't thought of yet.
say:15:1320433014:0.source_cn: 这不算什么，我还觉得自己想的不够多、不够好呢。

say:16:1320433015:0.source_cn: 你们也别再沮丧啦。就算没有新温泉，我也一定能想到别的办...

say:17:1320433016:0.source_cn: 对了，如果你们有什么好想法的话，一定要记得告诉我呦。

say:8:1320404002:0.source_cn: 哇……泡温泉好舒服呀，感觉身体里的疲惫都被热气融化了。

say:9:1320404003:0.source_cn: 不过，这水对满满来说有点深，呛到我好几次！

say:10:1320404004:0.text: ... Stupid Chippy. There are lots of rocks in the water, just sit on one.
say:10:1320404004:0.source_cn: ……笨满满，水里有很多石头，你可以坐在上面。

say:11:1320404005:0.text: Hey, don't call Chippy stupid! All the good spots were already taken! It's so crowded here today.
say:11:1320404005:0.source_cn: 这可不能怪我！温泉里人那么多，舒适的位置早就被占住了。

say:12:1320404006:0.text: We can always come back when it's less crowded. For now, let's thank the innkeeper for her hospitality.
say:12:1320404006:0.source_cn: 那等下次人少的时候，你再试试吧！我们现在先去找老板娘，...

narration:14:13020412:0.text: You find a quiet place and take a comfortable soak in the hot spring for a while.
narration:14:13020412:0.source_cn: 你们找了一块清静的地方，舒服地泡了一会儿温泉。
